newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NEDLLOYD TO POST NLG 20 MLN GAIN ON FERRIES DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NEDLLOYD TO POST NLG 20 MLN GAIN ON FERRIES DEAL.

text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said it would post an extraordinary gain of some 20 million guilders on the planned sale of its 50 pct stake in North Sea Ferries to The Peninsular & Oriental Steam Navigation Company (P&O) .
"The total consideration for Nedlloyd resulting from the sale amounts to approximately 200 million guilders which will be used to further reduce the interest-bearing debt," it said.

"In connection with the sale there will be a book profit of approximately NLG 20 million which will be accounted for as an extraordinary gain. Nedlloyd's ability to generate profits will not be negatively affected by the sale," Nedlloyd added.
